searchText: we should probably wait for monday's acdt to make a decision then if there are spec changes anyways, sepolia is dead in the water anyway Are people really talking this one for Glamsterdam? Yeah definitely waiting for acdt 😄 I'm very much on the fence of how to handle this, but right now I'm leaning towards [Mikhail's suggestion](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1570462426657202188/1570495017775136841) of doing the block hash check for Glamsterdam & adding `payload_root` later (maybe Heze). Yeah you can pull this strand and it can go very far. - small: just add payload_root - medium: add parent_payload_root, use the CL commitments to determine full vs empty - large: remove the envelope signature yes this should have been the design all along! builder signature is needed only for the bids, which would be good to find an anti-DOS way and then we can forget about BLS/XMSS for the whole path or just ditch P2P bids/trustless payments and take bids directly from builders
